summary: New Oriental Education & Technology Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release and notice of its annual general meeting, to be held November 13, 2026, at its Beijing headquarters. No proposals will be put to shareholders; the AGM serves as an open forum for holders of common shares and ADSs to discuss company affairs with management. The record date is October 23, 2026, and the fiscal 2026 Form 20-F has been filed. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply.
